<thought>The valid functional group name for an alcohol is “aliphatic hydroxyls”. I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break this group (i.e., correspond to deprotecting a trimethylsilyl ether back to the free alcohol). This should return the template ID and its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
